summary: Comprehensive backend testing of Mitharva AI completed. All 31 pytest tests passed (100%). Validated 19/19 endpoints from review request including auth flow (signup/login/me), JWT protection, profile patch, full interview session lifecycle (create→turn→complete with score aggregation + total_interviews increment), Gemini 3 Flash LLM integration (live calls succeed, with graceful fallback verified in logs), questions filtering, current affairs sorted desc, news question generation, mock Razorpay payment + billing history, and dashboard stats with radar & chart_data. MongoDB _id never leaked. Demo user pre-seeded with 12 sessions and 10 current affairs confirmed.

minor.issue: LLM key encountered a transient 'Budget exceeded' BadRequestError once during prior runs ($0.00127 cost vs $0.001 max budget). Backend fallback handled it correctly returning structured JSON. Subsequent calls succeeded — monitor budget headroom on the LLM key.

action_items: Optional: increase LLM API key budget cap to avoid sporadic fallback responses under heavy use.
Optional code quality: server.py is 712 lines — consider splitting into modules (auth, sessions, questions, subscription, seed) for maintainability.
Optional: /api/sessions/turn and /current-affairs/questions do not enforce that the session/news belongs to the user beyond session_id ownership check — current logic is correct, no action needed.
Minor: practice/feedback session_id uses datetime.now().timestamp() — could collide; consider uuid4 for LLM session id.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py at 712 lines violates the <700 LOC guideline — should be split into routers (auth.py, sessions.py, questions.py, subscription.py, dashboard.py, seed.py).
JWT_SECRET has a hardcoded default fallback 'change-me' on line 23 — for production should fail fast if missing.
_parse_json_loose silently returns wrapped fallback JSON for any malformed LLM output — good resilience, but the raw error is not logged at WARN level for observability.

Demo seed sessions all use mode='voice' regardless of camera_used flag (line ~666 has redundant ternary 'voice' if camera else 'voice') — likely a typo; second branch should probably be 'voice_camera'.
Pydantic SessionCreate.mode field accepts any string — no enum validation for ('voice','voice_camera','text').
No rate limiting on /sessions/turn or /practice/feedback which call paid LLM — could be abused.
interviews_used_this_month is incremented but never reset on month change (only reset on subscription upgrade) — needs scheduled reset or check on read.
CORSMiddleware uses allow_origins='*' with allow_credentials=True — browsers will reject; should specify explicit origins for production.
seed_data_creation: No new seed data created. Verified existing seeds: 30 questions (10 UPSC, 5 banking, 8 campus_it, 4 ssc, 3 campus_mba), 10 current affairs, demo user with 12 completed sessions. A few TEST_ prefixed signup users were created during testing (one per run).
context_for_next_testing_agent: All 19 backend endpoints listed in the review request pass functional tests via /app/backend/tests/test_mitharva_backend.py. Gemini 3 Flash LLM is live and returning real responses (verified via litellm success_handler logs); fallback path also verified to return valid structured JSON. Frontend testing was explicitly skipped per request. If retesting LLM endpoints, allow ~3-5s per call and tolerate transient 'Budget exceeded' as a known graceful-fallback path. After running, the demo user's plan gets upgraded to 'pro' and total_interviews increments — tests are idempotent but state-mutating.
